summary: RTB Digital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of RTB via a reverse merger, where a wholly-owned subsidiary of Ryvyl (now RTB Digital) merged with RTB. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated September 28, 2025, RTB issued 4,384,504 shares of common stock to former RTB shareholders as consideration. The merger closed on May 12, 2026, after stockholder approval and Nasdaq listing approval. The deal creates a combined entity focused on Web3 media. No advisor or break fee is mentioned. The regulatory clock ended. Watch for post-merger integration and stock performance under new symbol RTB.
